final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.TAT2 AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.TAT, 0)) AS patient_avg FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_groups AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg) AS sex_avg FROM patient_groups GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) AS overall_avg FROM sex_groups) SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg, s.sex_avg - o.overall_avg FROM sex_groups AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE s.sex_avg > o.overall_avg
